name: Botany Bay Hotel
accommodation: 30 en-suite bedrooms, many overlooking Botany Bay, including sea-view and family rooms
suitableFor: Families and couples wanting a hotel right by the beaches north of Broadstairs
beachAccess: A minute's stroll from the beach at Botany Bay, Kingsgate
confirmedFeatures: 30 en-suite rooms, sea views, food and drinks, function room, outdoor area, real fire, wheelchair access, Wi-Fi
overview: Botany Bay Hotel sits on the clifftop at Kingsgate, a minute's walk from the sand at Botany Bay and a short way up the coast from Joss Bay. Many of its 30 en-suite rooms look over the bay, there are family rooms, and food and drinks are served in the hotel, with an outdoor area and a real fire.
surfTripFit: The closest hotel to Joss Bay, with sea-view rooms that make it easy to check the north-east Kent coast before heading out.
